title: Risk Heat Map
description: Interactive p5.js 5x5 likelihood-by-impact risk heat map. Choose a sample risk, move the sliders, or drag the marker to see the score and the recommended treatment (Mitigate, Transfer, Accept, or Avoid) change in real time.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

educational.topic: Risk assessment, scoring, and treatment selection
learningObjectives: Place a risk on a 5x5 likelihood-by-impact grid and compute its score.
Analyze how the recommended treatment changes as likelihood or impact changes.
Distinguish Mitigate, Transfer, Accept, and Avoid as treatment options by risk band.
educational.prerequisites: Basic idea that risk combines likelihood and impact.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to justify a treatment choice and reason about appetite.
misconceptionsAddressed: Treating every high-impact risk as requiring mitigation regardless of likelihood.
Believing 'accept' means 'ignore' rather than a deliberate, monitored choice within appetite.

model.equations: score = likelihood x impact; bands: 1-4 Low, 5-9 Medium, 10-14 High, 15-25 Critical.
model.assumptions: Treatment recommendation is a teaching heuristic mapped from the score band; real treatment also depends on control feasibility, cost, and organizational risk appetite.
